fields.summary_ko.0: Saudi Aramco's Q3 net profit of $31.2B exceeded consensus of $28.7B, and increased from $28.6B in the same period last year due to rising oil prices.
fields.summary_ko.1: The downstream segment's adjusted EBIT surged 234% year-over-year to $10.3B due to strengthened refining margins, and Q3 2026 base dividend was maintained at $21.9B, up 3.5% from the previous year.
